::: {.content-section}

## Crediting OpenSpace
If you use OpenSpace images, videos, or visualizations in publications, presentations, articles, or other media, please credit the OpenSpace Project. A standard credit line:

```{.page-brand__credit-text}
Visualization created with OpenSpace — openspaceproject.com
```
For academic publications, please also cite the relevant OpenSpace software release or paper. Citation details are available in the [documentation](https://docs.openspaceproject.com).

:::

::: {.content-section}

## Usage guidelines
OpenSpace is open-source software released under the MIT License. Images and visualizations produced with OpenSpace may be used freely for educational, editorial, and research purposes with appropriate credit. For commercial use or licensing questions, [contact us](/community/contact.qmd).

When using the OpenSpace name or logo, please follow these guidelines:

  - Do not alter, distort, or modify the logo in any way.
  - Do not use the logo to imply endorsement or affiliation without permission.
  - Maintain sufficient contrast — use the white logo on dark backgrounds and the black logo on light backgrounds.
  - Provide adequate clear space around the logo.

:::

::: {.content-section}
